oneOf.title: system
oneOf.description: A star system at true scale inside a larger scene: a solar system in km at a point of a galaxy in light years. Its points and objects are in its own units (positions, sizes, offsets, fade, min_distance and max_distance) and keep their precision however small they are next to the scene; the camera works in the system's units while it is near. Ids are card-wide: views, fly-to, rules and paths name its points and objects as any others. Not rotated: its axes are the scene's.

shape_3.description: render: volume only: the form of the gas. clouds (default): the clouds themselves. shell: a thin hollow sphere (the Ring nebula). bipolar: an hourglass along the object's y axis, two hollow lobes joined at a narrow waist (the Butterfly). filaments: long thin strands running along the object's x axis (the Veil). cavity: a thick cup round a hollow that opens on the object's +z side (a blister, as in Orion). layers: a floor and a ceiling of gas across the region with a gap between (the Badlands): colors run from each sheet's surface into its depth; gap, veins, band and columns shape it. wake: a bright ribbon waving along the object's x axis near the bottom of the region and a sheet of gas trailing it upward (the Nexus): colors run from the ribbon out; ribbon and wake shape it. In every shape but clouds the clouds give the clumps and colours inside the form; turn it with rotation.

shared_12.title: belt
shared_12.description: An asteroid belt: a band of low-poly rocks round the object's centre (at), lit from the centre as by its star. Seeded, so the same config always gives the same belt.

seed.description: A different number gives a different belt.

shared_13.title: asteroid
shared_13.description: One irregular rock for a close look (lumps, craters, stretched its own way), tumbling, lit from its star (light). Seeded, so the same config always gives the same rock. Far away it shows as a dot. For many rocks round a centre use belt.

seed.description: A different number gives a different rock.

occlude.description: Hide labels and cards behind it.

shared_14.title: comet
shared_14.description: A comet: a small dark nucleus, a glowing coma round it and two tails pointing away from its star (light): a straight ion tail and a broader dust tail that bends back along the comet's path as it moves. Seeded. With activity.mode: distance it brightens and grows its tails as it nears its star.

type.description: comet: a nucleus, a coma and tails.

seed.description: A different number gives a different nucleus and tail.

shared_15.title: galaxy
shared_15.description: A spiral galaxy in 3D: seeded stars along a bar, a bulge, spiral arms and a thin disc, with soft glow on the arms and the core and dust lanes, at their real places (parallax as the camera moves). The Milky Way by default: the bar, Scutum-Centaurus and Perseus, Sagittarius and Norma, and the Orion spur; the Sun's place is 0.52 of the radius toward bearing 180.

seed.description: A different number gives a different scatter of stars.

shared_16.title: trail
shared_16.description: A line behind a moving point showing where it has been (a ship's wake, a planet's recent orbit), built while the card is open.

type.description: trail: where a moving point has been.

point.description: The id of the point to follow: one that moves (on a spinning ring, on a model part, or placed from an entity).

fade_tail.description: Fade from the colour at the point to black at the tail (the background, in space). false: one colour all along.

blend.description: add: light adds up where lines cross (a glow). Default normal.

shared_17.title: cube
shared_17.description: A Borg cube (shape borg, the default: carved machinery, a rail lattice, green light from inside and pulsing glow spots, as in the Borg screen effect) or a plain shaded box. Hides labels behind it.

type.description: cube: a Borg cube or a plain box.

shape.description: borg (default): the Borg cube. box: a shaded box with its edges.

enumDescriptions.borg: The Borg cube, ray-marched machinery under a rail lattice
enumDescriptions.box: A shaded box with its edges drawn

detail.description: borg: true (default) carves the machinery into the faces (ray-marched, about as costly as the screen effect's cube); false draws flat faces with the lattice, for slow graphics hardware.

seed.description: borg: where the glow spots sit. A different number moves them.

occlude.description: Hide labels and cards behind it.

shared_18.title: lightning
shared_18.description: Lightning: jagged forked bolts that flash and go at random places in a region (mode: strike), or held flickering columns from its floor to its ceiling (mode: column). A bolt inside a volume nebula lights the gas round it.

type.description: lightning: flashing bolts or held columns.

lights.description: Light the gas of every volume nebula a bolt is inside (true, default). false: the bolts only.

seed.description: Where the strikes fall and how the bolts are shaped: a different number gives different ones.

shared_19.title: crystalline
shared_19.description: The Crystalline Entity (Star Trek: The Next Generation): a glowing faceted spine along the object's y axis, a starburst core at its middle, and branches in tiers round it that fork again and again into thorns, inside a spindle size tall and 0.8 of that across. Glassy and translucent, lit from inside by its core. Seeded, so the same config always gives the same entity. Far away it shows as a dot; nearer, fewer fork levels draw. Turn it with spin.

seed.description: A different number gives a different branching.

blend.description: add (default): light adds up, so overlapping crystal glows. normal: drawn over what is behind.
